summary: Cat with Shred, Rake and Rip, plus Shifting Power and Shadowmeld into Ravage. Predatory Discipline lets Ferocious Bite keep its extra Energy. In Forever, Cat Form swings every 1.0s with the weapon's DPS. Stones, potions, Thistle Tea and Windfury Totem all work in Cat Form.
rotation: Opener: plain Cat Form, no Prowl. A Night Elf uses Shadowmeld in the fight for Ravage.
Racials, trinkets and potions on cooldown. Elune's Light with the on-use trinket, unless waiting for it would lose a use.
Shifting Power at 60 Energy or less
Ferocious Bite at any combo points in the last 2s
Rip at 4 combo points or more when it is down (not in the last 8s)
Ferocious Bite at 5 combo points and 45 Energy while Rip has 4s or more left (or in the last 8s). Predatory Discipline keeps the extra Energy, which still adds damage
Shadowmeld into Ravage from behind on Clearcasting, or in the last 10s with the Energy for it
Rake below 5 combo points when it is down (not in the last 6s)
caveats: Predatory Discipline's tooltip gives no number. The sim reads it literally: Ferocious Bite keeps its extra Energy and still deals 2.5 damage a point of it.
Rip's client ranks from level 31 up are 6-9% weaker than Era's. Era values would add 1.6% DPS.
Idol of the Dream (Rip lasts 2s longer) is 3.0 DPS ahead of Howling Idol at 180s.
Clearcasting is fished for before the pull. It's worth 4.6 DPS to the Night Elf.
Unverified: Shred's flat bonus, attack power on Rip and Ferocious Bite, and what Rend and Tear affects.
Rake's 5.5% of attack power a tick is fit to testers' rank 1 ticks. Keeping Rake up is 38-42 DPS ahead of skipping it.
Only one +2% crit elixir. Grizzly instead of Ferocity adds only its 25 Strength.
Tiger's Fury is gone in Forever.
Cat swings vary 20% either way. The server's real range is unknown.
The melee group has Windfury Totem and a second shaman's Grace of Air. No Elemental Sharpening Stone, since its recipe comes from Molten Core.
Takes Feral Swiftness 2 (movement speed). It costs nothing: the points it needs above Shredding Attacks would otherwise go to Furor, which does nothing for a cat that stays in Cat Form.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec feral (melee group: Strength of Earth and Windfury Totem, all blessings, own Leader of the Pack; latency 100 ms). Duration 180s, durationVariation 20. Forever lets the cat drink in form, so Mighty Rage Potion and Thistle Tea are used. Feral options: prepull Clearcasting on. No edits needed. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. 2026-11-01: on the launch realms' 2026-10-30 hotfix trees (tools/forever_talents/client/druid.json): talents and rotation from tools/rotopt/druid_presets.sh, the request's talentsString and rotation edited to match.
